# Agent Context Index

<!-- Generated by project-agent-generator-skill. Edit after verifying project facts. -->

- Project root: repository root
- Rule: facts are recorded from repository files; uncertain items are marked `TODO(agent)` or `inference`.

This directory contains agent-facing context for `My_skills`.

`My_skills` is the navigation and central-source hub for local Codex skills. The
root `README.md` and `README.en.md` are the canonical Chinese and English
repository overviews and inventories. Every numbered category has its own
bilingual README pair for human navigation, while each Skill's `SKILL.md`
remains the formal execution contract. Nine paper-build Skills live in
`10-paper-build/`, six project-build core Skills live in `20-project-build/`,
four reusable core Skills and the versioned skill registry live in
`50-core-utils/`, and one personal teaching Skill lives in `90-personal/`.
The root is the public `jiaqi-Sun2020/codex-skill-hub` monorepo. Agent context
remains in `.agents/` and project-scoped startup configuration remains in `.codex/`.

Recommended reading order:

1. `.agents/AGENTS.md`
2. `.agents/memory/MEMORY.md`
3. This `.agents/README.md`
4. `PROJECT_CONTEXT.md`
5. `ARCHITECTURE.md`
6. `CONFIG_SPEC.md`
7. `RUNBOOK.md`
8. `DECISIONS.md`

Files:

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `AGENTS.md` | Operational rules and safety constraints for AI coding agents. |
| `PROJECT_CONTEXT.md` | Project purpose, stack, docs, and verified context. |
| `ARCHITECTURE.md` | Directory map, module boundaries, entry points, and generated-output areas. |
| `CONFIG_SPEC.md` | Config files, environment surfaces, and editable settings. |
| `RUNBOOK.md` | Setup, run, test, build, and approval-gated commands. |
| `DECISIONS.md` | Durable decisions, ADRs, and unresolved project questions. |

Do not treat these files as a transcript. They should summarize stable project facts and owner-confirmed rules only.

`.agents/AGENTS.md` is the single project Agent entrypoint and points to
`.agents/memory/MEMORY.md`. The trusted project-local `SessionStart` and
`SubagentStart` Hook explicitly loads it; keep owner-verified facts when
refreshing it.
